mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.class_name, c.course_id, co.name AS course_name FROM class c LEFT JOIN course co ON c.course_id = co.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT a.*, af.file_url FROM answer a LEFT JOIN answer_file af ON a.id = af.answer_id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId} AND a.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource(title, description, course_id, class_id, user_id, uploader_role, visibility, status, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{courseId}, #{classId}, #{userId}, #{uploaderRole}, #{visibility}, 1, NOW())

INSERT INTO resource_file(resource_id, file_url, file_type) VALUES
(#{resourceId}, #{url}, 'attachment')
INSERT INTO answer(question_id, teacher_id, content, is_deleted, create_time) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{teacherId}, #{content}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT q.*, s.name as studentName, c.class_name, qf.file_url FROM question q JOIN course co ON q.course_id = co.id JOIN class c ON q.class_id = c.id JOIN user s ON q.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN question_file qf ON q.id = qf.question_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY q.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE resource SET visibility = #{visibility} WHERE id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: SELECT teacher_id FROM answer WHERE id = #{answerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE answer SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{answerId}
